ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark) ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white contiguous zones covering ~90% of both lobes; low-intensity black perimeter bordering the trailing and leading edges; a central low-intensity vertical band extending from the peduncle through the median notch; sparse, small low-intensity circular blobs distributed on the interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude jaggedness and pixel disruption observed at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of ~4-5 small dark circular pixel groups on the upper-mid region of the left lobe; ~2-3 similar clusters on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, low-intensity diagonal linear mark (~15 degree angle from vertical) located on the lower interior section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural and color-contrast anomaly (reddish-brown and white pixel cluster) at the far left distal tip, suggesting active or recent epibiotic colonization or tissue trauma.
